definitions.explanation: Two layers or folds of something, as opposed to single or multiple layers.
An eyelid with a visible crease. Short for {二重|ふたえ}まぶた.

notes:
NOTE ON READING:
The reading {二重|ふたえ} is used for layers/folds, while ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧ is used for "double" in other contexts (e.g., ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧ "dual nationality").

SENSE 2 - EYELID USAGE:
In beauty contexts, {二重|ふたえ} alone commonly means {二重|ふたえ}⟦まぶた→瞼：04269_mabuta⟧ (double eyelid with visible crease).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二重|ふたえ}⟦まぶた→瞼：04269_mabuta⟧ (double eyelid)
- {二重|ふたえ}⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧/⟦のり→糊：03895_nori⟧ (double eyelid tape/glue)
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{二重|ふたえ} (natural double eyelids)
- {二重|ふたえ}⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧ (double eyelid surgery)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧: single layer/fold, monolid
- {二重|ふたえ}: double layer/fold, double eyelid
- ⟦{奥二重|おくぶたえ}→奥二重：29807_okubutae⟧: inner double eyelid (crease partially hidden)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Double eyelid (blepharoplasty) surgery is one of the most common cosmetic procedures in Japan and Korea. Products like {二重|ふたえ}⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧ and {二重|ふたえ}⟦のり→糊：03895_nori⟧ allow temporary double eyelid creation.
